  SELECT batch_ref, 0, SUM(ledger_cents) FROM clearing_lines GROUP BY batch_ref

  LEFT JOIN current_bins AS c ON c.bin_key IS k.bin_key

WITH codes(code, position) AS (VALUES ('A', 1), ('B', 2), ('?', 3)), bin_keys AS (
  SELECT bin_key FROM old_bins UNION SELECT bin_key FROM current_bins
), transitions AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(o.code, '?') AS old_code, COALESCE(c.code, '?') AS current_code, COUNT(*) AS bin_count
  FROM bin_keys AS k
  LEFT JOIN old_bins AS o ON o.bin_key IS k.bin_key
  LEFT JOIN current_bins AS c ON c.bin_key IS k.bin_key
  GROUP BY COALESCE(o.code, '?'), COALESCE(c.code, '?')
)
SELECT a.code AS old_code, b.code AS current_code, COALESCE(t.bin_count, 0) AS bin_count
FROM codes AS a CROSS JOIN codes AS b
LEFT JOIN transitions AS t ON t.old_code = a.code AND t.current_code = b.code
ORDER BY a.position, b.position

WITH bookings(first_code, second_code, total_cents, forecast_signups, package_count) AS (
  SELECT package_code, NULL, fee_cents, signup_forecast, 1 FROM demo_packages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.package_code, b.package_code, a.fee_cents + b.fee_cents, a.signup_forecast + b.signup_forecast, 2
  FROM demo_packages AS a JOIN demo_packages AS b
    ON a.package_code COLLATE BINARY < b.package_code AND a.territory <> b.territory
)
SELECT first_code, second_code, total_cents, forecast_signups
FROM bookings
WHERE total_cents <= 10000
ORDER BY forecast_signups DESC, total_cents, package_count, first_code COLLATE BINARY, second_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1
